answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in a lagoon escrow as a delivery commitment: one dated package by the zenith. An ember stamp binds it to its key; auditors check it against the seal. Late or mismatched delivery burns it. First fake pays 70, 45 of work, and a slot fee of 12 rising 4 per later fake; 1,000 fakes pay 2,125,000 credits. A rented-delivery ring fails: each ember stamp is key-bound; duplicates are rejected. Honest agents pay 70 once.
